In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the rogue [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Fives/Legends|CT-5555]] '''escaped''' from the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center|Grand Republic Medical Facility]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he had been taken for evaluation by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. While there he was set up by the Chancellor to make it look like he was about to harm him and escaped the facility. He was pursued by several [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
